mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level compresses equity discount rates, leading to consistently negative S&P 500 forward returns across all observed rate levels over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is measured, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value above 315 signals persistent inflation, triggering monetary policy tightening that compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 315, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5) indicate monetary tightening combined with labor market weakness, signaling an impending recession and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and UNRATE > 4.5, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that triggers inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary policy tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong industrial production level (INDPRO > 102.5) indicates robust economic activity that supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 102.5, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high non-farm payrolls level (PAYEMS > 158000) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 158000, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 102.5) indicate robust demand and supply conditions that support positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200 and INDPRO > 102.5, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% (FEDFUNDS > 5.0) indicates tight monetary policy that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
